title: Michael Aquino says MJ meant non-human biologics in Space Command
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Michael Aquino says MJ meant non-human biologics in Space Command, about Cold War era at US Space Command, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: "Oh yeah, MJ, we had that in U that was in Space Command. We use that for non-aterrestrial biologics, right?"

plain: A researcher named Peter Levenda, on Jesse Michels' podcast, says a man named Michael Aquino once told him about the letters MJ, which appear on the MJ12 papers, a set of documents describing a secret group said to handle UFO matters. According to Levenda, Aquino said MJ was used in US Space Command, the military's space branch, as a label for non-human living beings. If true, it would mean the military had a working term for alien bodies.
